Iran rejects moving enriched uranium abroad, tells Pakistan army chief

Iran's security chief stated that the country will not permit any enriched nuclear material to leave its territory. This declaration was made to Pakistan's army chief, Asim Munir, who was in Tehran as part of Pakistan's efforts to mediate a peace deal between Iran and the United States. Iran conveyed that it would not engage in talks with Washington until its conditions are met. The Iranian security chief, identified in one report as Mohsen Rezaee, explicitly told Munir that not even a single gram of uranium would be sent out of the country.
